neighbours.label: inside an additive or 'apart from' framing clause (besides, apart from, not just that, aside from)
fire: Aside from the weather, our trip to Scotland was perfect.
Besides costing too much, the repairs took three months.
It isn't only that the rent is high; the flat is also damp.
Apart from a few scratches, the car survived the crash.
In addition to being late, the report was full of errors.
Quite apart from the danger, the climb is simply exhausting.
Not only is the soup cold, but it is also far too salty.
Other than a short delay, the flight went smoothly.
quiet: The weather made our trip to Scotland perfect.
The repairs cost too much and took three months.
The rent is high and the flat is damp.
The car survived the crash with a few scratches.
The report was late and full of errors.
The climb is dangerous and simply exhausting.
The soup is cold and far too salty.
After a short delay, the flight went smoothly.

notes: Card: 'not just that', 'apart from Damon being', 'Besides potentially', 'Quite apart from'. Probe: 0.21-0.48 with the framing, 0.006 for the plain paraphrase.
